title: Roomy One-Level * Near Downtown * Firepit & Fenced
description:
This single-story home is perfect for meals, memories, and late mornings! It's just an $8 Uber to Downtown Broadway’s live music honky-tonks or 1 mile to popular restaurants and bars. Walk to coffee and then relax in the fully fenced backyard with a firepit, hammock, and grill.  Inside, enjoy shuffleboard, slumber party projector room, and a 65” TV.  Your host is a full-time artist and 20-year resident who hopes to make your stay a beautiful one!

The space
A RARE FIND IN NASHVILLE! This fully detached home in a gated neighborhood with its own park and playground is close to all the best spots for adventure whether with your family, bachelorette, work, or friend's annual trip! 

AWESOME LOCATION
★ Walk to coffee
★ A mile to groceries, restaurants, bars, convenience
★ 10 mins to live music, downtown, and honky-tonkin'

PLAY OUTDOORS
★ Sunny deck with a firepit
★ Hammock, umbrella, & grill
★ Fully fenced backyard for dogs & kids
★ Lots of sun!

COMFORTABLE
★ 6 Memory Foam Queens + 2 Airbeds
★ Fully stocked kitchenware | Dining for 6-8
★ Blackout curtains, full-length mirrors, fans, extra outlets
★ No Stairs

ENTERTAINMENT
★ Shuffleboard & Projector
★ 65” TV
★ Fireplace

FAMILIES
★ Single-story | No stairs | Detached home
★ Playground & Park, just steps away
★ Slumber Party Projector Room
★ Gated, Safe Neighborhood

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
• Master – Queen, Ensuite Bathroom, Garden Tub, Workspace
• Guest 1 – Queen bed
• Guest 2 – Queen bed
• 20x20 Bonus Room – 3 Queen beds, space for airbeds
• 2 Airbeds

NEARBY ATTRACTIONS
• 1 mile – 8th Ave South restaurants
• 1 mile – Wedgewood-Houston bars & restaurants
• 2 miles – 12th South shopping & dining district
• 3 miles – Vanderbilt University & hospital
• 2.5 miles – Belmont University
• 3 miles – The Gulch (bars, restaurants, shopping)
• 4 miles – Broadway & downtown live music

Other things to note
*Complimentary k-cup coffee maker with k-cups and makings as well as a pot brew and ground coffee 
*Bedding, towels, paper towels, toilet paper, hair dryers, shampoo. Full kitchenware. This is an odds and ends house, not the minimalist style :)
*All Holiday bookings required 3 nights incl Fri/Sat with some exceptions over messaging
*Per person fee over 10. Enter your full group size for an accurate total from Airbnb
*See Pet Policy in House Rules for details
